audit.why: EVEN / 5.5 at 48.18% over 768 games: ranged bully early, Talon window at 5-6/first item, Akshan outscales — the content layer already carries this arc.
Spikes accurate: skill 3-5 around his E, Talon 6 and first item, Akshan late. All four spikes[] present, kit-grounded (Comeuppance is poke/execute, loses the straight all-in).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; Heroic Swing's 18s cooldown and the passive's three-hit shield were only in the content layer; Going Rogue camouflage (no Talon reveal — vision mandatory) missing entirely from the full layer.
audit.why: Kit: E cd 18/16.5/15/13.5/12, Q cd 9/8/7/6/5, P shields every third hit, W is camouflage + revive-on-Scoundrel-kill.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with numbers; camouflage/Scoundrel vision warning grounded into breakdown.feeding; shield-break note added.

audit.whatIsWrong: 3 lint findings: 2 copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d = tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d = tradeBad), cooldowns without a digit. report[8].t also prescribes anti-heal 'into his sustain' — Akshan has no heal in his kit.
audit.why: Deterministic lint; kit check confirms no heal flag on any Akshan ability.
audit.corrected: All fixed; anti-heal clause replaced with a real note.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows; content win[] and packet agree on Akshan 1-2, Skill 3-5, Talon 6/first item, Akshan late.
audit.why: Layers must agree; win[] already correct so sides edited alone per the chart rule, whys and ratings rewritten to match. Rows 2-3 stay Skill (already agreeing) — only their templated whys grounded.

edits.before: W the wave and his chest — the return pass is the damage; stand where the boomerang's geometry doubles.
edits.after: His 850-range Avengerang pokes both passes while you have no gapclose — last-hit safe, eat nothing free.

edits.before: Q-leap trades begin: W-Q-auto procs the bleed at 2 and most mids don't budget for it.
edits.after: His range and Heroic Swing mobility deny your W-Q trade — wait for level 3 and his E timer.

edits.before: Full kit: the parkour opens — every wall on mid's border is now a gank route or an exit visa.
edits.after: Full kit, but it hinges on his 18s Heroic Swing — commit only when it's down, W-slow first.

edits.before: Bleed-string the contacts: W both passes, Q the gap, auto the third stack. The lane bleeds rent.
edits.after: Trades hinge on his E timer versus your W-slow setup — bleed-string only in the 18s downtime.

edits.before: Shadow Assault online — the roam game doubles and the all-in wraps targets in a blade carousel.
edits.after: Shadow Assault out-bursts his poke ult — the all-in is yours before his lethality lead builds.

edits.before: First item spike: the full string one-rotations squishies. Shove and parkour — side lanes owe you taxes.
edits.after: Dirk spike: close from fog, W-slow, and R denies the swing escape — your best kill patch of the lane.

edits.before: Late Talon flanks from coordinates wards don't cover: R in, string the carry, blade-exit through the wall.
edits.after: Late his Q poke, passive shields and endless swings kite your one jump — dive only when his E is down.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - E Assassin's Path is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing (E): 18s at rank 1 — engage and escape in one button; fight only while it is down. - His Q is 9s early and his passive shields on every third hit — break contact before the third. Your E is the lifeline; the ult answers fights.

edits.before: If Akshan takes first blood, tighten up: Heroic Swing is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with W passes and stay relevant through roam tempo.
edits.after: If Akshan takes first blood, wards matter double: kills mark your team as Scoundrels and Going Rogue hunts them in camouflage — buy Control Wards, farm with W passes, and stay relevant through roam tempo.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: A crashed wave forces him to farm under tower while you parkour — a slow push left behind is his free roam ticket.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: With E up and his passive shield stacked, the swing kites your one jump — that duel favours him.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Profane Hydra or Eclipse, Lucidity, then Serylda's-Axiom paths. Lethality is the language. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Profane Hydra or Eclipse, Lucidity, then Serylda's-Axiom paths. Lethality is the language. Early pots blunt his Q chip poke.
